create_SemSegEvaluator: create a SemSegEvaluator instance for evaluating semantic segmentation metrics on a dataset
run_SemSegEvaluator_process: run SemSegEvaluator process to accumulate confusion matrices from model inputs and outputs
run_SemSegEvaluator_evaluate: run SemSegEvaluator evaluate to compute mIoU, accuracy, and boundary IoU metrics
use_load_image_into_numpy_array: use load_image_into_numpy_array to load a semantic segmentation image file into a numpy array
use_SemSegEvaluator_encode_json_sem_seg: use SemSegEvaluator encode_json_sem_seg to convert semantic segmentation masks to COCO RLE format
